subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the long-haired adult woman in black combat clothing and a cloak in <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> is the short-haired adult woman with a white fox mask and cyan-trimmed coat in <Picture 2>. Each character sheet supplies exactly one person. <Picture 3> supplies the rainy neon street and reflective road.

summary:
[reference generation] A five-second landscape 16:9 Ref2VA shot.

retention_analysis:
Retain each explicitly assigned reference identity, object and design. Character-sheet panels describe one subject, not multiple copies.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A continuous wide lateral shot. From 0 to 1 second both women face each other three meters apart. From 1 to 3 seconds they approach, and the first woman makes one diagonal swing with one short silver blade; the second blocks once with one blue energy dagger. From 3 to 5 seconds they hold the crossed blades apart from their faces. Keep both complete bodies, distinct identities and separate weapons visible. Rain, coats and reflections continue moving. No injury or blood.

overall_soundscape:
Rain and wet footfalls; one metal impact and brief electrical crackle. No speech or music.

non_diegetic_music:
None.
